title: Photo Recovery: Restore Files
summary: Scan your device and recover deleted photos, videos, and files in seconds.
description:
Accidentally deleted important photos or videos?
Photo Recovery: Restore Files is a powerful photo recovery and file recovery tool that helps you recover deleted photos, restore videos, and find lost files on your device in just a few taps.

🌟 Simple 3-Step Recovery
Recovering lost files is simple:
1️⃣ Start a scan
2️⃣ View and filter
3️⃣ Select and restore
The app organizes scan results by file type so you can easily find the photos, videos, or documents you want to recover.

🌟 Key Features
📷 Photo Recovery
Recover deleted photos from your device storage. Preview images before restoring them to make sure you recover the right files.
🎥 Video Recovery
Scan your device to locate deleted or hidden video files and restore them safely.
📃 File Recovery
Find recoverable documents such as PDF, DOC, XLS, and other common formats stored on your device.
🔍 Quick Scan & Deep Scan
Use quick scan to detect recently deleted files or deep scan to search more storage areas for recoverable data.
🧐 Preview Before Restore
Preview photos, videos, and files before restoring them.
↩️ Batch Recovery
Select multiple files and restore them together with a single tap.
📁 Smart File Organization
Scan results are automatically categorized into photos, videos, audio, and documents for easier browsing.
✨ AI Photo Enhancer
Enhance blurry, low-resolution, or old photos using AI. Improve clarity, sharpen details, and restore image quality in just one tap.

🌟 Supported File Types
- Photos: JPG, PNG, HEIC, GIF and other image formats
- Videos: MP4, MOV, MKV and more
- Documents: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPT and other files
- Audio: Common audio recording and music formats

🌟 Important Recovery Tips
For better recovery results:
• Run the scan as soon as possible after deleting files
• Avoid saving new data before scanning
• Use deep scan when quick scan cannot find the deleted files
Recovery success depends on device storage conditions and whether the deleted data has been overwritten.

🌟 Privacy & Security
- Your privacy is important.
- All scanning and recovery operations are performed locally on your device.
- We do not upload, store, or access your personal files.

🌟 Important Notice
- This app scans accessible storage locations to detect recoverable files.
- Files deleted before a factory reset or permanently overwritten may not be recoverable.
- Recovery results may vary depending on device model, storage condition, and file system status.

Photo Recovery: Restore Files helps you recover deleted photos, restore videos, and perform reliable file recovery directly on your Android device.
